newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs await FOMC for direction, spread seen stable.
newsitem.headline: OLOs await FOMC for direction, spread seen stable.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures built on opening gains in Wednesday afternoon trade to close 20 basis points higher in line with Bunds.

Dealers said domestic elements were pushed aside by the market's focus on the U.S. FOMC meeting on rates. But, whatever the outcome, they did not expect the OLO/Bund spread MEUR to move far away from its current six to nine bp range.

The benchmark 2007 OLO yielded 5.72 percent, down from 5.73 on Tuesday, and offering an unchanged seven bp over Bunds. Dealers said the market remained relatively liquid, but investors were shy to invest at yields at below six percent.
OLOs will track Bunds throughout the summer as talks on Belgium's 1998 budget -- which do not start in earnest until late August -- are not expected to bring nasty surprises.

Sound if relatively slow economic growth, tight spending control and ambitious budget deficit targets for the three years ahead will protect Belgian bonds and the franc from foreign selling, dealers said.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
